Reading · Unit 3
I have red, yellow, and blue paint.
What can I paint?

I paint red coral.
I paint yellow rocks.
I paint blue water.

I want to paint green seaweed.
I mix yellow and blue paint. That makes green.

I want to paint orange fish.
I mix red and yellow paint. That makes orange.

How about a purple crab?
I mix blue and red paint. That makes purple!

Now I have an aquarium. Colors are amazing!
1. What do I paint with blue?
(A) coral
(B) rocks
(C) water
(D) fish
2. How do I make green paint?
(A) mix red and blue
(B) mix yellow and blue
(C) mix red and yellow
(D) mix blue and purple
3. What is orange in the painting?
(A) fish
(B) rocks
(C) a crab
(D) seaweed
4. What is the final picture?
(A) a house
(B) a school
(C) a park
(D) an aquarium

Reading · Unit 4
Jane and Jack are best friends.
They both have dogs. Their dogs love to surf.
The dogs enter a contest.

The sun is hot. The waves are loud.
Many dogs wait to surf. One, two, three — go!

The dogs surf the waves.
Jane’s dog surfs a big wave. Her dog wins first prize.
Jack’s dog surfs a small wave. His dog wins second prize.

The two dogs play together. They are best friends too!
1. What is the story mainly about?
(A) the beach weather
(B) friends at school
(C) a dog surfing contest
(D) dogs at the park
2. Who are Jane and Jack?
(A) brother and sister
(B) teacher and student
(C) doctors
(D) best friends
3. What is the weather like?
(A) The sun is hot.
(B) It is raining.
(C) It is very cold.
(D) The sky is dark.
4. Which prize does Jane’s dog win?
(A) first prize
(B) second prize
(C) third prize
(D) no prize

Reading · Unit 5
Grandma and Grandpa came for dinner.
Anna and Carlos are helping Mom. It is time to set the table.

Anna has a knife for everyone. She puts five knives on the table.
Carlos has a fork for everyone. He puts five forks on the table.
Mom has a spoon for everyone. She puts five spoons on the table.

“Why do we need spoons?” asks Carlos.
“For the chocolate ice cream!” says Mom.
1. What is the story mainly about?
(A) cleaning the table
(B) helping with dinner
(C) setting for lunch
(D) using the spoons
2. Who has a knife for everyone?
(A) Mom
(B) Carlos
(C) Grandma
(D) Anna
3. How many forks does Carlos put on the table?
(A) a fork
(B) four forks
(C) five forks
(D) none
4. Why does Mom put spoons on the table?
(A) for everyone at the dinner
(B) for the chocolate ice cream
(C) for Anna and Carlos
(D) for Grandma & Grandpa
